data.headline: Broker-notified claims have materially higher leakage
data.interpretation: Broker-notified claims show a 1.51x leakage-rate lift versus the portfolio (23.5% vs 15.6%; n=1,337; p<0.01). The association survives stratification by claim_type: adjusted odds ratio 1.93, with 0% of the crude effect explained by that confound.

data.headline: High-complexity claims have materially higher leakage
data.interpretation: Claims with complexity_score >= 4 show a 1.37x leakage-rate lift versus the portfolio (21.4% vs 15.6%; n=2,824; p<0.01). The association survives stratification by claim_type: adjusted odds ratio 2.05, with only 0.3% confound explained.

data.headline: Claims with three or more prior claims have materially higher leakage
data.interpretation: Claims with prior_claims >= 3 show a 1.64x leakage-rate lift versus the portfolio (25.5% vs 15.6%; n=321; p<0.01). The association survives stratification by complexity_score: adjusted odds ratio 2.00, with 0% confound explained.

data.statement: Claims with both prior_claims >= 3 and complexity_score >= 4 have a higher leakage_flag rate than all other claims.
data.rationale: Tests whether repeat-claim history and complexity jointly identify a materially elevated leakage segment.

data.statement: Claims that are both broker-notified and high-complexity (complexity_score >= 4) have a higher leakage_flag rate than all other claims.

data.statement: Claims that are broker-notified and have at least three prior claims have a higher leakage_flag rate than all other claims.

data.statement: Claims with complexity_score >= 4 and days_to_report <= 14 have a higher leakage_flag rate than all other claims.

data.statement: The higher leakage rate for broker-notified, high-complexity claims persists after stratifying by claim_type.

data.headline: High-complexity claims remain elevated even when reported promptly
data.interpretation: Among claims reported within 14 days, high-complexity claims have a 20.8% leakage rate versus 15.6% overall (1.33x; n=2,245, p<0.001). The effect survives claim_type adjustment (adjusted odds ratio 1.72; confound fraction 0.5%; e_1cda59d323).

data.headline: Broker-notified high-complexity claims are a concentrated leakage segment
data.interpretation: The joint segment has a 32.6% leakage rate versus 15.6% overall (2.09x; n=530, p<0.001). The effect survives adjustment for claim_type with adjusted odds ratio 2.93, and claim-type composition explains 0% of the effect (e_0e7dc6ee6c).

data.recommendation: Route up to 200 claims matching (notification_channel == 'broker') & (complexity_score >= 4) to the special investigations queue before settlement, prioritising newly received claims within this segment.
data.expected_effect: Lower the leakage rate in the targeted segment from its observed 32.6% baseline toward 26% or below within 180 days.
